The '''Odacer-Faustin Sith academy''' was one of several [[Sith academy|Sith academies]] in operation during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The institution was originally constructed by [[Darth Drear]], but was overseen by [[Darth Scabrous]] during the reign of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] of the post&ndash;[[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] era. At the center of the academy sat [[Darth Scabrous's tower]], which was adjacent to the [[Odacer-Faustin academy library|academy library]]. The academy fell into chaos when the entirety of its [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] staff and student body fell victim to a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] that transformed them into [[Zombie/Legends|undead cannibalistic monsters]].<ref name="RH" />

Before the academy was infected in [[3645 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the staff included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Darth Scabrous, its [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]], and the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Dail'Liss]], its [[Librarian/Legends|librarian]].<ref name="RH" />
